settings.label: Open photos in
settings.description: Where a photo opens when you double-click it: in its own window, or in a pop-out that follows the photo chosen in the grid.

settings.label: Email size limit
settings.description: The most an email may carry, in megabytes. Bigger sets are offered smaller or split into several emails.

settings.label: Days counted as recent
settings.description: How many days "Recent" means in Browse.

settings.label: Scan network folders again
settings.description: Whether folders on the network are scanned again from time to time (folders on this computer are watched, so need no setting).

settings.label: Scan network folders every
settings.description: How often folders on the network are scanned again, when that is on.

settings.label: Auto tags
settings.description: Label photos with what is in them (beach, dog, ...), worked out on this computer.

settings.label: Find faces
settings.description: Look for faces in photos so people can be named in the People tab.

settings.label: Check for duplicates
settings.description: Look for photos that look the same, for the Duplicates tab.

settings.label: Distance that counts as away (km)
settings.description: Photos further than this from home, in kilometres, count as taken away from home. Trips need home to be confirmed first.

settings.label: Fewest nights in a trip
settings.description: A trip needs at least this many nights away; 0 allows a day trip.

settings.label: Size of a stop (km)
settings.description: Photos within this distance of each other, in kilometres, are one stop of a trip.
